jobs.title: Sr Project Manager Installation
jobs.description:
Securitas Technology, part of Securitas, is a world\-leading provider of integrated security solutions that protect, connect, and optimize businesses of all types and sizes. More than 13,000 colleagues in 40 countries are focused daily on our purpose to help make your world a safer place and our commitment to deliver an unparalleled client experience. With clients at the heart of all we do, our people, knowledge, and technology power our connected ecosystem of health, safety and security solutions and services.  

This role leads the systems integration projects, overseeing all stages including planning, initiation, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closing. The Sr. Project Manager is accountable for the overall success of the projects. They will manage each project from analysis and pre\-planning through implementation and closure.


The Sr. Project Manager is responsible for developing work plans, scheduling tasks, and managing the project to ensure it stays on track to meet scope, budget, and quality standards. They will also engage with customers and other relevant stakeholders as necessary and will oversee multiple projects simultaneously, each with different schedules, scopes, staffing, and requirements.

 **Position Responsibilities:**

* Effectively plan, execute, monitor, control, and close projects using appropriate principles, methods, and techniques tailored to each project's needs.
* Develop necessary planning documents such as project plans, scope documents, SOWs, charters, and schedules. Establish requirements to define scope, effort, timeline, funding, staffing, resource allocation, and metrics.
* Create sub\-plans, including communication, quality assurance, resource, procurement, and deployment plans.
* Manage the project by identifying and resolving issues/risks, handling change management, providing regular reports, and overseeing financials and metrics.
* Document, prioritize, and facilitate approval of project change requests, re\-planning as needed.
* Set and manage expectations with resource managers regarding allocation and performance.
* Ensure effective Quality Assurance/Quality Control processes are in place and followed.
* Oversee project closeout activities, including transition to operations teams.
* Collaborate with other groups and departments to ensure project success.
* Monitor and report on key metrics, including customer satisfaction.
* Lead the definition, execution, and delivery of project deliverables.
* Generate new ideas, techniques, and solutions to improve delivery quality, efficiency, and cost\-effectiveness. Share lessons learned across the organization.
* Coach and mentor new team members.
* Support other groups as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 **Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of relevant experience, or 5 years of experience in a security industry\-related role
* PMP certification preferred
* Proven track record of successfully leading multiple simultaneous projects for at least two years
* Proficient in applying Project Management methodologies, fundamentals, and tools
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail
* Comfortable interacting with all levels of management
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to document findings and recommendations
* Strong leadership, problem\-solving, and conflict resolution abilities
* Interpersonal skills that foster teamwork and relationship\-building
* Proficiency in scheduling tools, as well as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio

**Securitas offers comprehensive benefits including:**

* Highly competitive salary
* Company training and industry leading certification program
* Company Vehicle
* Company Cell Phone
* Opportunity for annual merit pay increases
* Paid company training
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Company Paid Short Term and Long\-Term Disability
* 401K with 60% Match up to 6% of salary
* Paid vacation, holiday, and sick time
* Educational Assistance
* Exceptional growth opportunities
* Wide variety of employee discounts on travel, equipment, and more!

  

We are a nationwide provider of security solutions, and an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. Our core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness are proudly demonstrated daily by our employees to our customers and the communities we service.

jobs.title: Cloud, Data and AI Solution Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: Cloud, Data and AI Solution Program Manager
Job Category: Engineering
Time Type: Full time
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None
Employee Type: Regular
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%
Type of Travel: Local
\* \* \*  

  

**The Opportunity:**  

CACI is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team supporting the DHS in designing, developing, testing, deploying, documenting, operating, and transitioning mission\-specific applications, enterprise data analytics capabilities, and artificial intelligence solutions. The program encompasses agile application development, cloud infrastructure, enterprise data platform implementation, a generative AI product sustainment and enhancement, Azure Commercial/GCC enablement, DevSecOps, and security authorization support. The Program Manager will serve as the primary contractor interface to DHS leadership and will be accountable for coordinating technical delivery, staffing, schedule, cost, quality, cybersecurity, and stakeholder engagement across the program.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**  

• Provide overall leadership and accountability for the successful delivery of cloud, data analytics, application development, and AI platform services.
  

* Serve as the primary contractor interface with the Government Contracting Officer’s Representative, Product Owner, technical stakeholders, cybersecurity personnel, and program leadership.
* Lead a multidisciplinary team comprising cloud architects, software developers, data engineers, AI/ML specialists, DevSecOps engineers, and other functional personnel.
* Translate Government priorities into an integrated program roadmap, delivery plan, staffing approach, and measurable program outcomes.
* Manage the design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and sustainment transition of pilot applications and mission\-specific AI and analytics capabilities.
* Oversee agile discovery, requirements development, solution architecture, prototyping, iterative development, testing, user acceptance testing, deployment, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Partner with the Government Product Owner to establish and prioritize product backlogs based on mission value, technical dependencies, risk, and available team capacity.
* Establish and facilitate Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Coordinate the phased implementation and sustainment of a secure and scalable enterprise data platform supporting centralized storage, governed access, data discovery, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, dashboarding, and secure collaboration.
* Oversee cloud and data platform activities involving Azure, Databricks, data lake architectures, data catalogs, analytics tools, visualization services, and AI/ML integrations.

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

*Required:*  

• U.S. Citizenship required
  

* Ability to obtain DHS EOD Public Trust
* BS/BA \+ 15 years or equivalency (AA \+ 17 years of experience, MS \+ 12 Years of experience or no degree \+ 21 years of experience)
* 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including progressively responsible leadership of complex technology programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary teams delivering cloud, software development, data analytics, or artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Experience leading federal technology programs involving multiple concurrent projects, products, or technical workstreams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage program scope, schedule, cost, staffing, quality, risks, dependencies, and contractual deliverables.
* Experience managing Agile software or product development using prioritized backlogs, iterative delivery, demonstrations, user feedback, and release planning.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture and delivery within Microsoft Azure or a comparable enterprise cloud environment.
* Understanding of modern application development, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, automation, APIs, monitoring, logging, and containerization.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Simple Chat or similar enterprise AI chat solutions.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to communicate complex organizational and technical changes in clear language tailored to different audiences.

*Desired:*  

* PMP or other Agile certification such as PMI\-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe Agilist, or comparable credential.
* 

**What You Can Expect:** 

**A culture of integrity.**

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high\-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.


**An environment of trust.**

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers \- every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.


**A focus on continuous growth.**

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

  

  

**Pay Range** :


There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. **Technical Business Analyst**  

**Remote**


Blu Omega is seeking a Technical Business Analyst to support a federal health program focused on public health initiatives. This role operates within a hybrid environment and is responsible for translating business needs into technical requirements within an Agile delivery framework. The position requires experience supporting IT, data analytics, or technical delivery environments and supporting government health or public health programs.


**Key Details**  

Location: Remote  

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust suitability determination


**Responsibilities**


* Partner with business users, Product Owners, and technical teams to elicit, analyze, document, and validate requirements.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and technical specifications.
* Facilitate requirement\-gathering sessions through stakeholder interviews, process reviews, use cases, and workflow analysis.
* Analyze existing systems and processes to identify gaps and automation opportunities.
* Develop recommendations to improve business processes and system functionality.
* Support Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, and sprint planning.
* Manage requirements, user stories, backlog items, and defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Support User Acceptance Testing and validate solutions during deployment.
* Maintain organized requirements documentation and process flow diagrams.


**Required Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of experience working directly with business system users to elicit and document requirements.
* Experience developing clear acceptance criteria with Product Owners.
* Experience within an Agile delivery framework and understanding of Agile principles and ceremonies.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools for requirements management.
* Ability to analyze complex business processes and create process flow diagrams.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and facilitation skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, data analytics, computer science, or a related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Supporting government health or federal programs.
* Experience as a backup Scrum Master or supporting Scrum Master duties.
* Knowledge of data structures, relational databases, and data governance principles.
* Professional certification such as CBAP, PMI\-PBA, or Agile certification.


**Compensation**  

Salary Range: $75,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00  

Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.


**Blu Omega Benefits \& Perks**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company\-paid Life and AD\&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short\-term disability (company\-paid) and long\-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 confidential support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options available through medical plans
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection options
* Paid Time Off (PTO) for eligible employees
* Paid federal holidays for salaried employees
* Access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits
* Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on role, employment status, and program requirements


**Company Overview**  

Blu Omega is a Woman\-Owned Small Business delivering technology and cybersecurity solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients nationwide. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission\-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data and analytics, and enterprise IT support. Our teams are experienced operating within federal contracting environments, supporting task orders, recompetes, and programs requiring cleared personnel and compliant delivery.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


This position is located in the Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families, headquartered in Washington, District of Columbia.  

  

This announcement will close at 11:59 PM, on the day that 100 applications have been received or on the closing date, whichever is first.

  

Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**


Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
### **Clarification from the agency**


Open to all U.S. citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY**  

  

As a Program Analyst (Data Analytics), you will:


* Collect, validate, and analyze program data to identify trends, evaluate performance, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Develop dashboards, data visualizations, reports, and briefing materials to communicate findings and recommendations.
* Manage and improve data systems, databases, and reporting processes to ensure data quality, accessibility, and integrity.
* Conduct program analyses and evaluations to assess operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen data collection, reporting, and system functionality.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* U.S. Citizenship required
* Males born after December 31, 1959 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service \- http://www.sss.gov
* Suitable for federal employment
* Appointment will be subject to the applicant's successful completion of a background security investigation and favorable adjudication. All information concerning qualifications is subject to investigation.
* Documentation that you present for purposes of completing the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Form I\-9 will be verified through the DHS "E\-Verify" System.
* All Federal employees are required to have Federal salary payments made by direct deposit to a financial institution of their choice.
* All qualification requirements must be met by the closing date.
* Financial disclosure statement may be required.
* Probationary (or trial) period may be required.

### **Qualifications**


**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:** You must have one year of specialized experience to perform successfully the duties of the position. To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the **GS\-12** grade level in the Federal service performing at least ALL of the following:


* Collecting, validating, and analyzing statistical and qualitative program data, including sensitive and personally identifiable information (PII), to identify trends, evaluate program effectiveness and support leadership with data\-driven decision\-making.
* Developing interactive dashboards, data visualizations, and written and oral reports to communicate complex findings and actionable insights to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Managing data systems, databases and reporting processes to ensure data quality, accessibility, security, and compliance with organizational requirements.
* Collaborating with ombuds, audit, or investigative offices, as well as other stakeholders to improve data collection, reporting, and system operations.


  

**Documenting experience:** IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC. WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Qualifications are based on breadth/level of experience. In addition to describing duties performed, applicants must provide the exact dates of each period of employment (from MM/YY to MM/YY) and the number of hours worked per week if part time. As qualification determinations cannot be made when resumes do not include the required information, failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Applicants are encouraged to use the USAJOBS Resume Builder to develop their federal resume.  

  

**Do not copy and paste the duties, specialized experience, or occupational application questionnaire from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.**  

  

In accordance with Office of Personnel Management policy, federal employees are assumed to have gained experience by performing duties and responsibilities appropriate for their official series and grade level as described in their position description. Experience that would not normally be part of the employee's position is creditable, however, when documented by satisfactory evidence, such as a signed memorandum from the employee's supervisor or an SF\-50 or SF\-52 documenting an official detail or other official assignment. The documentation must indicate whether the duties were performed full time or, if part time, the "percentage of times" the other duties were performed. It is expected that this documentation is included in the employee's official personnel record. In order to receive credit for experience in your resume that is not within the official series and grade level of your official position, you must provide a copy of the appropriate documentation of such experience as indicated above.  

  

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through national Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; community; student; social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to gain employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. If such experience

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, product leadership, and engineering teams across our platform portfolio, including a regulatory registry platform, a business identity verification platform, and a business messaging platform. In this role, you will translate complex business, customer, and regulatory requirements into actionable solutions that drive product development and operational excellence. You will partner with stakeholders, internally and externally, to ensure our platforms deliver value while meeting expectations.

**Our Team**


GCH Technologies was established to deliver innovative and transformative solutions to the telecommunications industry. Founded by industry veterans with extensive experience in messaging and wireless, GCH serves as a neutral party dedicated to advancing the wireless ecosystem.

**What You Will Do**

* Own business requirements, functional specifications, process documentation, and user stories across our registry, identity verification, and business messaging platforms.
* Translate customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements into clear, testable solutions for Engineering and QA teams.
* Maintain traceability between business requirements, development work, and acceptance criteria.
* Own requirements through delivery, ensuring work is clearly defined, implementation risks are addressed, and solutions meet business objectives.
* Analyze, document, and maintain current and future\-state business processes, workflows, business rules, and system interactions.
* Identify process improvements, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies that create value across the business.
* Evaluate cross\-product impacts and promote consistency across shared workflows, data models, and customer experiences.
* Partner with Product Management on discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, and solution definition.
* Collaborate with Customer Success, Operations, customers, and external stakeholders to capture business needs and validate solutions.
* Facilitate alignment across internal and external stakeholders through clear communication, documentation, process modeling, and solution validation.
* Define reporting and analytics requirements supporting operational KPIs, SLAs, and customer reporting.
* Analyze platform data and translate insights into actionable recommendations that support product, operational, and strategic decisions.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Experience gathering, documenting, and managing requirements through functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related artifacts
* Experience facilitating backlog refinement, stakeholder workshops, and cross\-functional solution discussions
* Experience supporting system integrations and API\-driven solutions, including documenting data flows, business rules, and integration requirements.
* Experience with process analysis, process mapping, and documentation skills using tools (Confluence, Lucidchart, Miro, or similar platforms)
* Experience partnering with software engineering teams and external development vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Experience analyzing data using SQL or similar tools to support business decisions
* Experience operating in a B2B or SaaS environment supporting customers and contractual service commitments
* Experience building or supporting similar platforms in any industry, such as registries or compliance systems, identity or entity verification systems, or messaging/communications platforms

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience in telecommunications, messaging, or wireless ecosystems, including short codes, A2P messaging, rich business messaging, or carrier integrations
* Experience leveraging KYC/KYB processes, identity verification platforms, or business entity data management
* Experience with billing and subscription management platforms (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar)
* Experience supporting regulated industries, industry associations, or compliance\-driven business environments
* Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight
* Experience with website user experience (UX), including customer\-facing web flows, usability, and design collaboration with UX/UI teams
* CBAP, PMI\-PBA, or similar business analysis certification
* Spanish fluency


For this role, we anticipate paying $115k\-$145k per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

**Hiring Philosophy**


All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**


At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**Our Benefits**

jobs.title: Program Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

Steampunk is seeking a **Program Operations Analyst** who is excited about contributing to solutions and outcomes in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. The ideal future Punk will thrive working across all levels of the organization, partnering with supporting teams such as Finance, Contracts, Recruiting, HR, IT, and Security, as well as Project and Program Managers and Directors.  

  

The Program Operations Analyst will support a variety of business and program operations activities, including project coordination, administrative and logistical tracking, contract\-related activities, compliance and operational processes, resource management, reporting, and process improvement. The Punk will be expected to stay organized across multiple priorities, communicate effectively with stakeholders, identify and resolve issues, and contribute ideas that improve the way work gets done.  


Contributions:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide administrative\-level project coordination and operational support for assigned programs, projects, and initiatives, with support extending across the portfolio or organization as business needs require.
* Assist with planning, organizing, tracking, and implementing projects and initiatives in support of program and organizational leadership.
* Conduct research, create and facilitate presentations, and collect and analyze data to produce reports that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with program leaders and cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities to streamline processes and develop or improve procedures.
* Provide excellent customer service by researching, resolving, identifying, and/or clarifying issues for internal and external stakeholders.
* Use systems, databases, trackers, and other tools to maintain information, track responses and activities, identify issues, and ensure effective follow\-through.
* Analyze current processes and systems and assist with developing, testing, implementing, and documenting process and system improvements.
* Work with a multidisciplinary team across Contracts, Finance, Recruiting, Operations, Human Resources, IT, Security, and program teams to identify and resolve operational needs and improve business processes, procedures, and methods.
* Maintain accurate and organized documentation while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proactively communicate status, updates, questions, issues, and potential roadblocks to appropriate stakeholders.

  


Qualifications:
* Located in the Washington, DC Metro Area.
* Ability to work onsite three (3\) days per week.
* 2\+ years of working experience.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills.
* Self\-starter with strong attention to detail, discretion, the ability to anticipate needs, and the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels of an organization.
* Good judgment, the ability to act with a sense of urgency, and comfort working through ambiguity.
* High degree of respect for confidentiality.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and work well under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills, a customer\-centric attitude, and a desire to foster and support cultural diversity.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with flexibility and adaptability as priorities and needs evolve.
* Good prioritization and time\-management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities.
* Experience using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

jobs.description:
**Technical Business Analyst**

 **State’s Attorney’s Office for Charles County, Maryland**



The State’s Attorney’s Office for Charles County (SAO) is seeking a highly motivated and analytical **Technical Business Analyst** to support the Office’s use of data, technology, and business processes to improve operational efficiency and support data\-informed prosecution.



The Technical Business Analyst will serve as a connection between people, processes, data, and technology. This position will evaluate how work is currently performed, identify opportunities for increased efficiency and automation, recommend practical technology solutions, assist with implementing improvements within existing systems and platforms, and conduct statistical analysis of data to generate reports.



The ideal candidate is a curious, solutions\-oriented problem solver who enjoys understanding how systems and processes work, identifying opportunities for improvement, and using technology and data to develop practical solutions.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Evaluate business processes, workflows, and technology systems to identify opportunities for increased efficiency, automation, and operational improvement.
* Work with staff and leadership to understand business needs, identify problems, and develop practical technology\-based solutions.
* Analyze current workflows and translate operational needs into clear business and technical requirements.
* Recommend and assist with the implementation of process improvements, system enhancements, and automated workflows.
* Assist with system configuration, testing, development, integrations, and implementation as appropriate.
* Evaluate and maximize the capabilities of the SAO’s case management, digital evidence, and other technology systems.
* Analyze, extract, and interpret data from SAO systems to support strategic planning, crime reduction efforts, and data\-informed decision\-making.
* Develop and maintain accurate reports, dashboards, spreadsheets, tables, graphs, maps, and other data visualizations.
* Identify and address data quality, reporting, workflow, and system issues.
* Develop and document processes, procedures, workflows, and best practices.
* Support the implementation of new or enhanced technology, automation, and business processes.
* Work with staff, leadership, vendors, and agency partners on technology and process improvement initiatives.
* Research emerging technologies, automation capabilities, and industry best practices and recommend opportunities that may enhance SAO operations.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.
  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in business analytics, information systems, computer science, data analytics, mathematics, statistics, economics, business administration, or a related field.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to evaluate business processes and technology systems and identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
* Ability to analyze and interpret data and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to learn and effectively use new software, databases, and technology platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and spreadsheets.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively to research problems and implement solutions.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive criminal justice information.
  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in business analysis, systems analysis, process improvement, data analysis, or technology implementation.
* Experience with workflow automation, system configuration, and integrations.
* Experience gathering business or technical requirements and documenting workflows or procedures.
* Experience with SQL, databases, data extraction, or data transformation.
* Experience developing dashboards, reports, or data visualizations.
* Experience with case management, digital evidence, or other specialized information systems.
* Familiarity with the criminal justice system or experience working with criminal justice or government data.

  


**Starting Salary:** $75,000

Click "**Apply for This Job**". Upload the required documents and complete the application in its entirety.

  



Deadline for completed applications: September 4, 2026

  



You will receive an email notification that your application has been received. For questions, please respond to that email.

  

**Successful candidate must be willing to relocate to work in\-person and provide identification upon hire.**

jobs.title: Project Manager – Labels & Packaging
jobs.description:
Imprimus Labels \& Packaging is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support a key strategic customer in the Santa Clarita, CA area. This is a highly customer\-focused role responsible for managing projects from initial request through production and delivery while coordinating across customer, vendor, and internal manufacturing teams.


This position is ideal for someone with experience in label printing, flexible packaging, or commercial printing who excels at managing multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and customer requirements in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.


The position will work remotely from a home office but must be located near Santa Clarita and available to meet frequently in person with customer and vendor contacts in the area. Occasional travel to our Brea, CA manufacturing facility will also be required.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage customer projects from initial request through production and final delivery.
* Coordinate product launches, new SKUs, transitions, artwork changes, material changes, regulatory updates, and other customer\-driven initiatives.
* Develop project timelines, establish priorities, track milestones, and ensure deadlines are met.
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day liaison between the customer and internal and external teams.
* Coordinate artwork and prepress activities, including proofs, revisions, specifications, approvals, and final customer sign\-off.
* Coordinate with customer, vendor, supply chain, planning, production, quality, and customer service teams.
* Manage project requirements involving pre\-production, production, expediting, shipping, labeling/marking, and logistics.
* Monitor open orders, production schedules, inventory, and delivery commitments and proactively identify potential delays or risks.
* Coordinate priorities, rush requests, and expedite requirements while balancing customer expectations with manufacturing capabilities and lead times.
* Work closely with Planning and Production regarding capacity, materials, tooling, scheduling, and delivery requirements.
* Support customer inventory programs, forecasts, anticipated demand, and shipment releases.
* Coordinate with Quality on customer complaints, corrective actions, credits, and final resolution.
* Research and resolve order discrepancies, delivery issues, pricing questions, specification concerns, and other customer issues.
* Facilitate project and status meetings with customer, vendor, and internal teams.
* Maintain accurate project, order, account, and customer documentation.
* Identify recurring service or operational issues and work cross\-functionally on continuous improvement opportunities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience required.
* Associate's or bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Project Management, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management, account management, customer service, sales support, or a related customer\-facing position in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Experience in label printing, flexible packaging, or commercial printing is required.
* Experience supporting large, complex, multi\-location, or strategic customer accounts preferred.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects from development through manufacturing and delivery.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing workflows, production scheduling, materials, artwork/prepress, quality, and logistics.
* Experience with domestic and international logistics is preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn ERP, CRM, estimating, artwork, and manufacturing systems.
* Bilingual English/Mandarin is preferred but not required.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for someone who is exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, responsive, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from beginning to end. The successful candidate will be able to manage changing priorities, anticipate potential problems, communicate effectively with customers and manufacturing teams, and keep multiple projects moving forward simultaneously.


Strong communication and relationship\-building skills are essential. You should be comfortable working across departments and influencing priorities without direct authority.

**Work Location**
-----------------


This is a remote/home\-office position based near Santa Clarita, California. Frequent in\-person meetings with customer and vendor contacts in the Santa Clarita area are required, along with occasional visits to our Brea, CA manufacturing facility.


Imprimus is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate business reasons. Imprimus does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on any characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal law.

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**  

  

Manage transformer service projects from planning through completion, overseeing scope, schedules, resources, budgets, vendors, and customer communication. The role coordinates cross\-functional teams, addresses project risks and execution challenges, tracks performance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives. Project work supports the reliable maintenance and repair of transformer assets while helping ensure successful project execution, customer satisfaction, and compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements.
  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**  



* Manage the full lifecycle of transformer service projects from initiation through closure.
* Develop project plans, including scope, timelines, resource allocation, and budgets.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third\-party contractors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, maintaining communication and managing expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues while developing contingency plans.
* Monitor project progress, track KPIs, and provide regular updates to management.
* Manage project budgets, approve expenditures, and support cost\-effective project delivery.
* Support post\-project reviews and continuous improvement of project management processes and tools within the Services Division.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

  

**Your Background**

* Candidate must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for Hitachi Energy in the United States.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field, or an associate degree with more than seven years of experience in the transformer or substation field.
* Minimum of five years of experience in project management with a focus on transformer services or heavy industrial equipment.
* Experience delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Understanding of transformer technology, maintenance, and repair processes preferred.
* Proficiency with project management software, including MS Project or Primavera P6\.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is highly desirable.

  

**More About Us**  

  

This role offers exposure to transformer service projects, customer engagement, cross\-functional collaboration, and process improvement within the Services Division.  

  



* Work on transformer service projects supporting the maintenance and repair of power infrastructure assets.
* Collaborate with experienced professionals, including engineers, technicians, subcontractors, vendors, sales teams, and project stakeholders.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities, post\-project reviews, and the development of project management processes and tools.
* Access learning and development opportunities through project execution, collaboration, and process improvement initiatives.
* Health and retirement benefits are available as part of Hitachi Energy’s total rewards offerings.
* Paid leave and flexible work programs are available in accordance with company policies.
* Travel domestically and internationally to meet with customers, vendors, and sales teams.

\-

jobs.description:
About Cognizant Consulting
  
Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice. We’re a global community of 5,000\+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you? About the Role
  
As a Consulting Manager, Claims Modernization (QNXT Migration) Program Manager , you will make an impact by leading large\-scale healthcare transformation programs focused on claims platform modernization, operational excellence, and business growth. You will be a valued member of the Healthcare Consulting team and work collaboratively with business leaders, product owners, architects, UX/UI teams, API developers, vendors, and client stakeholders to successfully execute complex claims modernization initiatives.
  
In this role, you will combine program leadership, stakeholder management, and healthcare domain expertise to drive the successful delivery of enterprise\-scale transformation programs while enhancing member and provider experiences. In This Role, You Will:
  
Lead and manage a large\-scale, multi\-year healthcare claims modernization and QNXT migration program across multiple workstreams and cross\-functional teams.
  
Establish and govern integrated program plans, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, critical paths, and risk management activities using Microsoft Project.
  
Drive Agile delivery execution through sprint planning, backlog prioritization, release planning, Jira governance, stakeholder reviews, and program performance tracking.
  
Manage program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, resource utilization, cost management, and executive reporting.
  
Collaborate closely with business, technology, QA, UX/UI, API, data, vendor, and client teams to ensure successful program outcomes and delivery commitments.
  
Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks, dependencies, and issues while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives.
  
Provide executive\-level status reporting, Steering Committee presentations, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision\-making.
  
Ensure adherence to governance frameworks, quality standards, compliance requirements, and organizational delivery methodologies.
  
Drive stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, and change management activities to support successful adoption of modernization initiatives. Work Model
  
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What You Must Have to Be Considered
  
Proven experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation, modernization, or migration programs within complex organizations.
  
Extensive expertise in program and project management using Microsoft Project, including integrated planning, scheduling, dependency management, resource planning, and risk tracking.
  
Demonstrated experience managing Agile delivery programs, including sprint planning, backlog management, release planning, stakeholder reviews, and Jira\-based execution tracking.
  
Experience managing program financials, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and executive financial reporting.
  
Strong leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and align business, technology, vendor, and client organizations. These Will Help You Succeed
  
Healthcare payer industry experience with knowledge of claims administration, benefits, enrollment, provider operations, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
  
Experience leading QNXT implementation, migration, upgrade, or claims platform modernization initiatives.
  
Experience presenting program status, risks, financials, and key decisions to executive leadership and Steering Committees.
  
Familiarity with healthcare integration technologies, APIs, data migration, interoperability solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.
  
Experience collaborating with UX/UI, cloud modernization, digital transformation, and vendor partner teams.
  
PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, Scrum, or other relevant project and program management certifications.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed.
  
Compensation
  
$105,000 \- $129,500
  
This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.
  
Benefits
  
Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  
401(k) plan and contributions
  
Employee stock purchase plan
  
Employee assistance program
  
10 paid holidays plus PTO
  
Paid parental leave and fertility assistance

**Overview**
------------


At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.


* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: On\-site
  

As Technical Program Manager for the ADVEV platform, you will be a key driver in orchestrating the delivery of software products for the next\-gen EV Platform. You will work closely with senior\-level management, Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and development teams to translate strategic roadmaps into tangible product features.


This is a "Builder\-TPM" role that demands an AI\-native approach, blending strategic product thinking, a software engineering mindset, and prompt engineering. You will not only manage delivery but will actively build prototypes and contribute to technical automation, leveraging agentic workflows and AI tools to optimize business capabilities and innovation within the ADVEV space at FORD.


* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape and operationalize the portfolio roadmap into AI\-augmented delivery outcomes.


* Build and iterate on prototypes to validate roadmap objectives and translate them into structured execution plans: milestones, release slices, sequencing, and readiness gates.


* Drive iteration and release planning sessions through a product lens, ensuring scope, dependencies, and capacity are aligned and explicit.


* Facilitate targeted ceremonies and working sessions to drive decisions, unblock delivery, and maintain operational efficiency.


* Contribute to technical discussions as an execution integrator, connecting product, engineering, operations, security/compliance, procurement, and vendor stakeholders.


* Define and drive key execution metrics and dashboards (delivery health, readiness, quality, operational adoption), enabling proactive issue detection and resolution.


* Treat recurring program operations as engineering problems: prototype and build AI agents to automate reporting, status visibility, dependency tracking, and routine documentation.


* Lead and support the development of internal AI automation to accelerate the creation of PRDs, runbooks, executive summaries, and decision logs from raw inputs—improving consistency and reducing manual effort.


* Coordinate operational execution for vendor and licensing workflows as needed (renewals, seat tracking, approvals, procurement checkpoints).


* Ensure vendor\-related dependencies (security, access, onboarding requirements) are planned early and do not become release blockers.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.


* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, or Software Engineering.


* AI\-Native Skillset: Proficiency in prompt engineering and a track record of building agentic automation and chatbots to accelerate execution.


* The "Builder" Experience: Demonstrated experience building prototypes, contributing to codebases, or developing internal tools to solve complex problems.


* Product \& Engineering Lens: Proven ability to bridge the gap between customer\-centric product strategy and technical engineering execution.


* Demonstrated proficiency with Jira and Confluence (or equivalent tools) to run execution systems at scale.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Technical Contribution: Experience using VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, or other AI\-assisted tooling to write automation scripts, lightweight fixes, or build POCs instead of writing PRDs


* Experience with GCP, Mongo, and SQL to build dashboards, metrics, and operational reporting systems that drive proactive execution.


* Agile/Scrum leadership experience in automotive or highly integrated platform environments.

-------------------------------------


Speak up. We’re listening. At Ford, we believe the right ideas, and the people behind them, can move an entire industry. Here, you'll work with teams who value your voice, push bold ideas forward, and leave a mark that lasts.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



Anduril's Detection and Response team is looking for a Security Operations Analyst to be the watchtower for Anduril's critical defense technologies. As a SecOps Analyst on the detection and response team, you'll be responsible for monitoring and responding to adversarial activity while helping incorporate key detection feedback loops with the detection engineering team. As a Senior SecOps Analyst, you will serve as an incident commander alongside other senior analysts. When not responding to threats, you'll be asking questions of our data sets, conducting threat hunting and data normalization operations across the organization to understand user behavior and identify anomalies.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Triage and respond to alerts / incidents covering multiple disciplines including, but not limited to, phishing, endpoints, cloud infrastructure and services, and SaaS applications
* Build and optimize tailored detection signatures, response playbooks, and response automation using detection\-as\-code principles
* As the frontline of DNR, you will lead the feedback loop for detections, ensuring alerts are fine tuned to reduce false positives
* Participate in threat modeling scenarios with cross\-functional partners to understand weaknesses across Cloud, Mobile, Endpoints, and other environments incorporating findings into security controls and/or detection signatures
* Organize and conduct threat hunting and data baselines to identify anomalous patterns in data
* Participate in an on\-call rotation responding to security events and conducting incident response investigations while effectively communicating findings to key stakeholders. As a Senior SecOps Analyst, you will serve as an incident commander as necessary.
* Proactively collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, guiding detection and response maturity of key worlds, leading incidents and large\-scale data baselines, and being responsible with mentoring and guiding junior analysts.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience in security monitoring, log analysis, and detection engineering within large data sets across endpoint, network, and a wide variety of application log sources
* Experience in Python development, specifically contributing to a shared codebase used for automating SOC operations
* Must have experience with one or more SIEM languages (SPL, KQL, SQL)
* Experience conducting analysis in a data lake environment
* Broad range of practical security knowledge across the spectrum of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud infrastructure
* Knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) across Windows, Linux, MacOS, AWS/Azure, etc.
* Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with internal and external stakeholders
* Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience conducting incident response in the Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Digital Forensics and/or reverse engineering experience is a plus!

##### **Job Description**


**Job Title/Designation: Senior Project Manager**

**Location: Torrance, CA**

  

**Overview**


Vector USA is seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to lead the successful delivery of complex physical infrastructure and technology projects. The primary focus of this role is the management of **physical layer infrastructure**, including structured cabling systems, fiber optic networks, copper cabling, pathways, telecommunications spaces, and outside plant infrastructure. In addition, the ideal candidate will possess strong project management experience delivering integrated technology solutions including **IP surveillance, electronic access control, wireless networking, and enterprise IT infrastructure**.


The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, execution, financial performance, quality, and successful completion of assigned projects. This individual will lead projects from pre\-construction through closeout while ensuring delivery on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements and client expectations.


The successful candidate must possess exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and build strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders. This role requires a proactive leader capable of identifying and mitigating project risks while maintaining a relentless focus on safety, quality, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.


The Senior Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned projects and is fully accountable for project scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk management, procurement coordination, and stakeholder communications.

  

  

**What Your Typical Day Will Be**


* Lead all phases of the project lifecycle including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and project closeout.
* Manage large, complex physical infrastructure projects involving structured cabling, fiber optic systems, telecommunications infrastructure, pathways, data centers, and outside plant construction.
* Manage integrated technology projects involving IP surveillance systems, electronic access control, wireless infrastructure, and enterprise networking.
* Review and interpret RFPs, RFQs, Statements of Work, contract documents, specifications, engineering drawings, and construction documents.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules utilizing Microsoft Project, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), resource loading, critical path analysis, milestones, and baseline management.
* Develop project execution plans, staffing plans, procurement strategies, and project budgets.
* Monitor project financial performance including forecasting, earned value, labor productivity, cost\-to\-complete, margin protection, and change management.
* Lead internal project kickoff meetings and client kickoff meetings.
* Facilitate recurring project status meetings with clients, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Establish project expectations, communication plans, governance standards, and escalation procedures.
* Manage subcontractors, suppliers, field personnel, and technical resources to ensure successful project execution.
* Proactively identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Manage project scope, negotiate changes, prepare change orders, and maintain contract compliance.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, company standards, applicable codes, and industry best practices.
* Deliver projects that consistently meet quality standards, schedule commitments, financial objectives, and customer expectations.
* Mentor junior Project Managers and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
  

  

**What You Bring to the Table**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of military, technical, and industry experience.
* **7\+ years of progressively responsible Project Management experience**, including management of medium to large technology infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated expertise managing **physical layer infrastructure** including:
* Structured cabling systems
* Fiber optic infrastructure
* Copper cabling systems
* Telecommunications pathways and spaces
* Outside plant construction
* Data center infrastructure
* Additional experience managing one or more of the following:
* Electronic Access Control Systems
* IP Video Surveillance Systems
* Enterprise Wireless Networks
* LAN/WAN infrastructure
* Network switching and routing
* IT infrastructure deployments
* Strong understanding of construction project management principles, scheduling methodologies, procurement, estimating, subcontract administration, and contract management.
* Advanced knowledge of project controls including scheduling, forecasting, budget management, earned value concepts, risk management, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple concurrent projects ranging from several hundred thousand dollars to multi\-million\-dollar programs.
* Strong client\-facing skills with experience managing executive\-level customer relationships.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing project profitability and forecasting.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Project.
* Experience with ERP, project management, and construction management platforms such as Procore, FileMaker, or similar systems is preferred.
* Ability to travel as required to customer sites throughout assigned regions.

jobs.title: Senior, Business Analyst - Tax Transformation
jobs.description:
If you are a technology visionary with a passion for transforming global tax business with digital technology, consider working with the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to support global execution of Deloitte's tax strategy as we shift from "doing digital" to "being digital" by reimagining how we engage with our clients, deliver our services, operate our business, and create value.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Deloitte Tax Business Analyst, Senior you will be responsible for understanding the business needs, models, trends, and transformation vision. You will identify changes required to meet the business need by consideration of organization structure, business functions, required knowledge and skills, processes and technology. You will explore possible solutions by coordinating with technical architects for discovery and demonstrate how proposed solutions are aligned to business goals and objectives and define the impacts and risks.  

  

Responsibilities include:  

* Use business goals and objectives to assist Product Owners in developing a product roadmap.
* Perform business analysis tasks and/or coordinate tasks across the Service Delivery Transformation program.
* Identify solution options that meet the business need, then coordinate with delivery teams to determine the best solution approach.
* Assist Product Owners in defining release scope, including defining benefits and risks during the discovery phase.
* Develop supporting artifacts including requirements, solution options, recommendations, business flows, where required.
* Make connections with other initiatives in place, underway or planned across other parts of the organization that need to be considered.
* Work with architects and delivery teams to ensure the functionality meets the needs of the enterprise and aligns to the overall vision.
* Actively identify and champion innovation initiatives supporting the business strategy.
* Develop and maintain productive and collaborative relationships with Product Owners, and various SMEs across the organization to support Service Delivery Transformation efforts.
* Explore and assess applications of AI, machine learning, and automation to streamline tax business processes, generate data\-driven insights, and create value for our clients.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Clear technical communication \- Ability to communicate business needs, functional requirements, technical concepts, assumptions, dependencies, and solution trade\-offs clearly and concisely.
* Cross\-functional collaboration \- Ability to work effectively with Product Owners, architects, developers, delivery teams, and subject matter experts to resolve requirements and maintain solution alignment.
* Requirements facilitation \- Ability to support discovery sessions, requirements workshops, backlog refinement, solution reviews, and other delivery discussions.
* Structured problem solving \- Ability to evaluate business and technology challenges, identify impacts and risks, and develop practical recommendations in a changing environment.

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP's ability to deliver comprehensive, value\-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:  

* Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co\-locate in person 2 \- 3 days per week
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years' experience supporting technical delivery teams and conducting product development using different software development. methodologies, like Agile and Scaled Agile.
* Demonstrated ability to elicit, analyze, document, and validate business requirements, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to connect business goals, operating models, processes, and technology solutions to identify opportunities and support informed recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with Product Owners, architects, developers, tax professionals, subject matter experts, and delivery teams.
* Ability to document current\-state and future\-state processes, identify gaps and dependencies, and recommend improvements aligned to business objectives. Business and process modeling are core capabilities for senior\-level analytical roles.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* One of the following active accreditations obtained in process, or willing/able to obtain:
* + Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA
	+ If not CPA eligible:
	+ - Licensed attorney
		- Enrolled Agent
		- CBAP® \- Certified Business Analysis Professional
		- Certified SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager
		- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
		- Project Management Professional (PMP)
		- Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt)
		- Alteryx Designer \- Advanced Certification


  

Preferred:  

* Ability to create clear requirements, business flows, use cases, solution recommendations, process maps, and other delivery artifacts.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communic

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

**About the Team**


Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud\-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data\-driven decision\-making.


Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end\-to\-end implementations and process improvements. As part of our growing consulting practice, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that help organizations modernize their finance functions and support long\-term growth.

**About the Role**


Crowe seeks a **NetSuite Implementation Manager** to lead ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role oversees project delivery, manages client relationships, and leads consulting teams throughout implementation engagements. You will guide the full implementation lifecycle including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.


The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with NetSuite functional knowledge and supply chain expertise. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, and order management processes is highly valued.


This role requires managing multiple projects while mentoring consultants and ensuring strong client outcomes. You will partner with client leaders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams. Together, you will design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency and inventory visibility.


This position is comparable to roles such as NetSuite Project Manager or NetSuite ERP Consulting Manager.

**Core Skills**


NetSuite ERP, ERP Implementation, NetSuite Financials, Manufacturing ERP, Supply Chain ERP, SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite Advanced Manufacturing, NetSuite Advanced Inventory, NetSuite Demand Planning, NetSuite Order Management, NetSuite WMS, ERP Consulting, Financial Systems Implementation, NetSuite Integrations, Business Process Transformation, ERP Project Management

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead NetSuite ERP implementations in several industries (with an emphasis on Manufacturing and Distribution) from discovery through post\-go\-live support.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring successful client outcomes.
* Gather and document business requirements related business processes.
* Facilitate requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and user acceptance testing sessions.
* Configure NetSuite modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and multi\-entity financial consolidations.
* Implement operational modules including Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Demand Planning, and Manufacturing; with working knowledge of project\-based or subscription billing for services clients.
* Support manufacturing processes including bill of materials, work orders, production planning, and shop floor operations.
* Configure workflows and reporting using SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, and other NetSuite platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with technical teams implementing integrations with WMS, ecommerce, logistics, and supply chain systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.
* Mentor consultants and analysts while supporting knowledge sharing across implementation teams.
* Ensure successful client transition to post\-implementation support or managed services tea

* Demonstrated ability to lead and coach within a matrixed environment
* Strong experience working with public sector clients
